name: corexpert
description: AI-powered vehicle damage assessment and repair marketplace

scripts.deploy:dev: cd packages/cdk && pnpm cdk deploy --all --context env=dev
scripts.deploy:prod: cd packages/cdk && pnpm cdk deploy --all --context env=prod
scripts.deploy:web:dev: pnpm build:web && cd packages/cdk && pnpm cdk deploy Corexpert-dev-Frontend --context env=dev
scripts.deploy:web:prod: pnpm build:web && cd packages/cdk && pnpm cdk deploy Corexpert-prod-Frontend --context env=prod
